JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Cheree, Gerald, Natacha, Savanna, Staci, Youlanda

What do the rest of you think? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi everyone, I'm Savanna. My top skill is infrastructure (0.81). I see Gerald and Cheree are interested in ISSUE-0001 (data-science). To ensure we cover more tasks, I'm looking at ISSUE-0002, specifically ISSUE-0002::review or ISSUE-0002::test, as they match my skills well.

Hi everyone, I'm Staci. My skills are infrastructure (0.88) and data-science (0.74). Given our goals, I'm interested in helping finish ISSUE-0001 since it's critical. Gerald, Cheree, Savanna - how about I take ISSUE-0001::docs? Natacha and Youlanda, what are your thoughts?

Hi everyone, I'm Natacha. My top skill is infrastructure (0.64). Gerald, Cheree, and Staci seem to have ISSUE-0001 mostly covered, but I can take ISSUE-0001::triage (critical) to help finish that set, as my cost for it is manageable. - Gerald: ISSUE-0001::implement (critical)

Hi everyone, I'm Youlanda. My top skill is infrastructure (0.93) and I also have data-science (0.64). Gerald's plan sounds great. I'll take ISSUE-0001::test (critical) to help complete the critical tasks. My cost for it is 2.84. This ensures we cover all the critical items. Looking forward to it!

Great, the plan is finalized. Everyone has a task and we've covered all critical items plus one medium task.

The plan is set. I'm confirmed for ISSUE-0001::docs. Ready for the execution phase.
